content: Saw you're hiring three SDRs this quarter. How are you handling the list building side right now?
We already use Outreachly for that.
Makes sense. How are you using it today, on which part of the funnel? Asking because the LinkedIn side is what most teams still do by hand.
Honestly that's the messy bit. We export and do it manually.
Quick one on your outbound setup, are you running LinkedIn and email from the same place?
Way out of our budget I'm sure.
It starts lower than you'd think and it pays for itself fast. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk you through the pricing and show you a demo of what it can do.
Noticed Gamma just opened a Berlin office. Is the outbound team growing with it?
Not a priority for us right now, we're mid-migration to a new CRM.
Makes sense. What's the CRM move, and when do you expect it to land? Happy to circle back after rather than during.
HubSpot, should be done end of July. Ping me then.
Saw your post on outbound attribution. Curious how you're measuring reply quality today?
Where did you get my details? I never signed up for anything.
You mentioned scaling outbound without more headcount. What's blocking that today?
Too expensive for where we are.
Fair. Expensive compared to what, out of curiosity? Helps me tell you straight whether it's worth your time.
Compared to the 300 a month we pay now for email only.
How's the SDR team splitting time between sourcing and selling right now?
I'm not the right person, we outsourced all of our outbound last year.
Quick question on your prospecting stack, are you enriching before or after the import?
I'm actually a student looking for an internship, not a buyer.
You wrote about reply rates dropping across the board. What are you seeing on LinkedIn specifically?
We tried a tool like this in 2024 and it tanked our acceptance rate.
That's worth knowing. Was it the tool itself or everything around it, volume, targeting, that sort of thing?
